caption: The drawing depicts a diamond-shaped (or rotated square) segment with a green background, on which there are four separate, smaller diamond-shaped sections outlined by dotted or dashed dark lines. Within each section, there are botanical motifs consisting of slender, branching stems with clustered leaves and round, fruit-like forms. The leaves and branches are dark green or black and the fruits are brownish with darker accents. The overall surface has areas of distress or wear, showing irregular lighter patches and scratches. The entire diamond-shaped design is set on a plain, off-white rectangular background, with no other visible objects or elements outside the primary geometric and floral pattern.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
